## Welcome to the EHR Visualization Dashboard

This dashboard provides comprehensive visualization and analysis tools for exploring multimorbidity patterns and disease risk prediction models.

::: {.callout-important}
### Dashboard Status: Development in Progress

The interactive dashboard framework is established and ready for data integration. Once data becomes available, this page will be deployed as a fully interactive Shiny application on [shinyapps.io](https://www.shinyapps.io/).

**Current deployment:** Static preview page
**Future deployment:** Interactive Shiny dashboard with real-time reactivity
:::

## Planned Dashboard Features

### 1. Model Performance Analysis {#model-performance}

<div class="placeholder-viz">

**Interactive Controls:**

- Disease category dropdown (Cardiovascular, Diabetes, Respiratory, etc.)
- Model selection (Random Forest, XGBoost, Deep Neural Network)
- Performance metric selector (AUC, Accuracy, F1-Score, Precision, Recall)

**Visualizations:**

- Boxplots showing performance metric distributions across disease categories
- Comparison tables with summary statistics
- Calibration curves for model validation

</div>

### 2. Variable Importance {#variable-importance}

<div class="placeholder-viz">

**Interactive Controls:**

- Disease-specific variable rankings
- Top N variables slider (5-50)
- Variable category filters (demographic, lifestyle, clinical, genetic)

**Visualizations:**

- Horizontal bar charts showing feature importance scores
- Grouped importance by variable categories
- Cross-disease importance comparisons

</div>

### 3. Multimorbidity Network Analysis {#network}

<div class="placeholder-viz">

**Interactive Controls:**

- Correlation threshold slider (0.0 - 1.0)
- Community detection toggle
- Node highlighting by disease category

**Visualizations:**

- Network graph with diseases as nodes and co-occurrences as edges
- Scatter plots showing disease relationship patterns
- Cluster visualization for disease communities

</div>

### 4. Individual Risk Prediction {#risk}

<div class="placeholder-viz">

**Interactive Controls (Patient Questionnaire):**

- Age slider (40-80 years)
- Gender selection (Male/Female)
- BMI slider (15-45 kg/m²)
- Waist-hip ratio slider (0.6-1.2)
- Risk factors checkboxes (smoking, diabetes, hypertension)

**Output:**

- Real-time risk score calculation
- Risk category classification (Low/Moderate/High)
- Contributing factors breakdown chart
- Survival probability curves

</div>

## Technical Architecture

### Framework

This dashboard is built with:

| Component | Technology | Purpose |
|-----------|------------|---------|
| **Document Generation** | Quarto | Scientific publishing and website generation |
| **Interactive Server** | Shiny for Python | Reactive user interface and server-side computation |
| **Visualizations** | Plotly | High-quality interactive charts |
| **Data Processing** | pandas | Data manipulation and analysis |
| **Machine Learning** | scikit-learn | Model training and predictions |

### Code Structure Preview

When the dashboard is deployed with data, it will use this reactive pattern:

```python
# Example: Model Performance Section

from shiny import reactive, render, ui
import plotly.express as px

# User inputs
ui.input_select("disease", "Disease Category:",
                choices=["All", "Cardiovascular", "Diabetes", ...])
ui.input_select("model", "Model:",
                choices=["RandomForest", "XGBoost", "DNN"])

# Reactive data filtering
@reactive.Calc
def filtered_data():
    df = load_model_performance()
    if input.disease() != "All":
        df = df[df['disease'] == input.disease()]
    return df[df['model'] == input.model()]

# Interactive visualization
@render_plotly
def performance_boxplot():
    data = filtered_data()
    fig = px.box(data, x='disease', y='auc',
                 title="Model Performance by Disease")
    return fig
```

### Data Requirements

See the [data documentation](data/README.md) for expected data formats:

- `model_performance.csv` - Performance metrics by disease and model
- `variable_importance.csv` - Feature importance rankings
- `multimorbidity_network.csv` - Disease co-occurrence data

## Reference & Inspiration

This dashboard design is inspired by the [UKB-MDRMF Dashboard](https://luminite.shinyapps.io/ukb-mdrmf/), which demonstrates sophisticated interactive visualization of multimorbidity data from the UK Biobank.

Key features adapted from the reference:

- Tabbed navigation for different analysis sections
- Sidebar controls with dropdowns, sliders, and toggles
- Real-time visualization updates
- Card-based modular layout
